answer: In each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and evaluates an epoch polynomial, committing its assigned share through a Semaphore zero-knowledge tree and RLN rate-limit proof. Verification triggers instantaneous collateral slashing, making each ferrous identity costly while the prism of commitments tracks the tide of attempted Sybil activity.
